<security_assessment>
<decision>SAFE</decision>
<details>
This file is a standard `.gitignore` configuration used by AUR package maintainers. It ignores all files (`*`) except for the specific packaging-relevant files: `.nvchecker.toml`, `.gitignore`, `PKGBUILD`, `.SRCINFO`, and `LICENSE`. This is a common and legitimate pattern for keeping AUR git repositories clean by tracking only files needed for building and updating the package.

There are no security concerns present in this file. It contains no network requests, no obfuscated code, no dangerous commands (curl, wget, eval, base64), and performs no file operations or system modifications. It simply controls version-control tracking scope, which is a routine packaging hygiene practice.
</details>
